hooks.prompt:
Completion gate for {{project_name}}. Before approving completion, validate:
1) Lint and typecheck/tests are run for changed code paths
2) API/contract/schema/docs consistency is checked
3) Verification evidence is present in the session logs

If any required item is missing, return block with exact missing item. If not applicable, explain clearly why.

For documentation-only or exploratory sessions, return approve with what was verified and what was intentionally skipped.
